"import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc

class TurbojetDesign(om.Group):
    def setup(self):
        # Thermodynamic data: TABULAR method with AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC
        thermo_data = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC
        thermo_method = pyc.ThermoMethod.TABULAR

        # 1. Flight Conditions (Sea Level, Mach ~ 0)
        self.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightCondition())

        # 2. Inlet
        self.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet(thermo_data=thermo_data, thermo_method=thermo_method))

        # 3. Compressor (AXI5 map)
        self.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(map_data=pyc.AXI5, thermo_data=thermo_data, thermo_method=thermo_method))

        # 4. Combustor
        self.add_subsystem('burner', pyc.Combustor(thermo_data=thermo_data, thermo_method=thermo_method))

        # 5. Turbine (LPT2269 map)
        self.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine(map_data=pyc.LPT2269, thermo_data=thermo_data, thermo_method=thermo_method))

        # 6. Nozzle (Convergent-Divergent)
        self.add_subsystem('nozzle', pyc.CDNozzle(thermo_data=thermo_data, thermo_method=thermo_method))

        # 7. Shaft connecting Compressor and Turbine
        self.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_inlets=1, num_outlets=1))
